snippet.title: Sovereign's End Trailer
snippet.description:
Sovereign's End is a 3D space action roguelike with deep build-crafting and auto-firing abilities. Fly. Position. Survive long enough to see what the build becomes.

🎮 PLAY THE DEMO NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4297420/Sovereigns_End/
🚀 LAUNCHING: June 23, 2026

Forge your build run by run. Choose abilities, chase synergies, and cross Breakpoint thresholds that transform how you play. Master Overdrive - ride the edge between cold and overheated. Face four factions across escalating phases until you confront The Sovereign itself.

The Sovereign is waiting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT THE GAME

- 16+ unique Cores with distinct abilities (4 playable in the demo)
- 30+ abilities with deep synergy potential
- Build crafting with Breakpoint thresholds
- Overdrive + heat management system
- Four enemy factions: Hive, Aegis, Cursed, Void
- Deep meta-progression workshop
- Global, friends, and local leaderboards
- Steam Achievements
- Endless mode for pilots who refuse to stop
- Built solo with obsessive attention to feel

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FOLLOW THE JOURNEY

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/uB8bzDRe9q
🐦 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/nqrgames.bsky.social
📧 Press inquiries: support@nqrgames.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STREAMERS & CONTENT CREATORS

This game is monetization-friendly. Streamers, YouTubers, and content creators are welcome to play, stream, and create content from Sovereign's End freely. For press kits, review keys, or coverage requests, email cchegwidden@nqrgames.com.
